boundary.description: From the junction of Bury New Road and St Mary’s Road, W along St Mary’s Road, Rectory Lane, Whittaker Lane, Bent Lane, Ostrich Lane. Then N along Bury Old Road, Singleton Road, Park Lane, Bury New Road to the point opposite its junction with Broom Lane. Then W by a bee-line to and NW along River Irwell to the point opposite Kingsley Avenue and by a straight line to the junction of Kingsley Avenue, South Radford Streey and Monsal Avenue by a bee-line to the River Irwell to the point opposite Grundy Avenue and E to the junction of Grundy Avenue and Cawley Avenue. Then E along Cawley Avenue, Lowther Road, Shrewsbury Road, Butterstile Lane and N along Bury New Road to its junction with St Mary’s Road.
